fields.name: Molten Shell

fields.name: Bloodthirsty Pounce

fields.desc: Advantage: smell Wis (Percept) checks.

The first time it enters a creature’s space on a turn creature takes 3 (1d6) fire and must make DC 15 Str save or be knocked prone.
fields.name: Blazing Maelstrom Form

fields.desc: Doesn’t require air food drink or sleep.
fields.name: Elemental Nature

fields.desc: For every 5 ft. it moves in water or for every gallon of water splashed on it it takes 1 cold.
fields.name: Water Susceptibility

fields.desc: No beast with Int 3 or less can willingly attack the crone. They can be forced to do so through magical means.
fields.name: Beast Passivism

fields.desc: Can communicate with Beasts and Plants as if they shared a language.
fields.name: Speak with Beasts and Plants

fields.name: Cursed Plant

fields.desc: When it takes fire damage catches fire taking 3 (1d6) fire at start of each of its turns. Burns until it takes cold or is immersed in water. Creature that touches wind witch or hits it with melee attack while within 5 ft. of it while it is burning takes 3 (1d6) fire. While burning deals extra 3 (1d6) fire on each melee attack and deals 7 (2d6) fire to a captured creature at start of its turn.
fields.name: Flammable

fields.name: Sunlight Regeneration

fields.name: Incorporeal Movement

fields.desc: While animating a pile of wrack has AC 18 and can use Slam and Deluge actions. Also loses its immunity to grappled and restrained conditions and can’t fly. If it moves through a creature or object with Incorporeal Movement while animating wrack wrack falls off its ghostly body ending this. Otherwise can end this as bonus action. If it takes 15+ damage in single turn while animating wrack must make DC 13 Con save or be ejected from wrack ending this.
fields.name: Wrack Form

fields.desc: Any creature that begins its turn within 30' of wraith: DC 13 Cha save or become cursed losing its resolve in important oaths it has taken. While cursed creature has disadvantage on Con saves to maintain concentration and can’t add its proficiency bonus to ability checks and saves in which it is proficient. On success creature is immune to wraith’s Aura of Oathbreaking for 24 hrs.
fields.name: Aura of Oathbreaking

fields.name: Oathseeker

fields.name: Sunlight Sensitivity

fields.desc: Can move through a space as narrow as 1' wide with o squeezing. Any equipment worn/carried is left behind when it goes through a space too small for the equipment.
fields.name: Amorphous

fields.desc: Enters corpse of a Small Medium or Large creature that has been dead less than 24 hrs impersonating it for 2d4 days before body decays. If xecha takes 15 damage or more on a single turn while inhabiting body it must make DC 15 Con save or be ejected from the body which falls apart and is destroyed. Its stats except size are same in each body.
fields.name: Assume the Dead

fields.desc: Advantage: spell/magic effect saves.
fields.name: Magic Resistance

fields.desc: Even when in plain sight it takes a successful DC 16 Wis (Perception) check to spot a xecha that has neither moved nor attacked. A creature that tries to enter the xecha’s space while unaware of it is surprised by the xecha.
fields.name: Transparent

If thrown target strikes a solid surface target takes 3 (1d6) bludgeoning damage per 10 ft. it was thrown. If target is thrown at another creature creature takes same damage and knocked prone (DC 12 Dex negates both).
fields.name: Flinging Pounce

fields.desc: Long jump is up to 40' and its high jump is up to 20' with or with o a running start.

fields.name: Eidetic Memory

fields.desc: Advantage on Wis (Perception) checks and on saves vs. being blinded charmed deafened frightened stunned and knocked unconscious.

Area is heavily obscured and difficult terrain. When creature enters area for first time on a turn or starts its turn there: 7 (2d6) poison (DC 14 Con half). Smoke lasts for 1 min or until a wind of moderate or greater speed (at least 10 miles per hr) disperses it.
fields.name: Smoldering Death
